_comment: Aviation Safety Network (ASN) CSV export mapping.
IMPORTANT: ASN data requires a license agreement before bulk ingestion.
Contact aviation-safety.net before using this mapping with real ASN data.
This mapping is provided for reference and testing against sample data only.
ASN CSV columns (as of 2024 export format):
date, type, registration, operator, fat., location, country, phase,
nature, departure airport, destination airport, narrative, acc_no
To ingest: atlas ingest generic-csv --filepath asn_export.csv --mapping asn
To dry-run: atlas ingest generic-csv --filepath asn_export.csv --mapping asn --dry-run
